title: Website Development & Redesign
description: Website builds and redesigns with accessible page structure, practical content workflows, technical SEO foundations, and a documented handoff from JustinJ Industries.
intro: Build a useful website around what visitors need to understand and do. JustinJ Industries connects page structure, implementation, accessibility, and the practical details of keeping a site current.
fit: For a new business site, a focused redesign, or an existing site whose content and visitor paths have become difficult to maintain.
deliverables: A page and content plan tied to the agreed visitor journeys, including campaign landing pages where scoped.
Responsive implementation with semantic structure, keyboard access, visible focus, and clear form states.
Page titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, and an indexable sitemap appropriate to the agreed scope.
A review record, deployment notes, and a practical maintenance handoff.
process: Review the existing site, content, hosting, and priorities.
Agree on the pages, design direction, platform, inputs, and acceptance criteria.
Build and review across desktop and mobile, then document the agreed release.
prepare: Share the current URL, the pages you need, examples of visitor tasks, and any platform or hosting constraints. Avoid sending passwords or private customer information.
boundary: Copywriting, CMS work, migrations, integrations, hosting, and ongoing updates depend on the written scope. Accessibility conformance should be validated for each project’s scope, content, and platform.

title: Analytics & Tagging Implementation
description: Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) implementation, Adobe Analytics/Tags QA, and reporting in Analysis Workspace or Data Studio.
intro: Make measurement understandable and testable. JustinJ Industries helps connect website interactions to an agreed measurement plan, with clear event definitions and a record of what was validated.
fit: For teams preparing an implementation, troubleshooting inconsistent events, or reviewing whether existing reporting reflects the actions they actually need to understand.
deliverables: A measurement plan with agreed events, data-layer specifications, parameters, and acceptance criteria.
GA4/GTM configuration, or Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Platform Tags (Adobe Launch) specification, rule and payload review, according to scope.
Consent and data-handling considerations documented alongside the tagging design.
QA evidence and handoff notes, with Adobe Analytics Analysis Workspace reporting or Data Studio dashboards where agreed.
process: Review business questions, the site, existing tags, consent behavior, and access requirements.
Define events and exclusions before configuration, including what must never enter analytics.
Validate agreed journeys, compare expected and observed behavior, and document the result.
prepare: Share the site URL, the questions reporting should answer, and the tools already in use. Access should be granted through the relevant platform; do not send account passwords or customer records.
boundary: Server-side tagging, reporting deliverables and complex integrations require an agreed scope. Adobe mobile SDK support is limited to specification review, debugging and validation. A button click does not by itself establish a qualified lead, completed sale, or connected phone call.

title: WordPress & Craft CMS Support
description: WordPress and Craft CMS implementation support, content-template improvements, maintenance review, QA, and practical editor documentation from JustinJ Industries.
intro: Keep the publishing workflow practical for the people who use it. JustinJ Industries supports WordPress and Craft CMS work with attention to templates, content structure, testing, and clear handoff notes.
fit: For an existing CMS site that needs a defined improvement, a clearer editing workflow, or a reviewed maintenance and support plan.
deliverables: A review of the relevant templates, content model, editor workflow, and dependencies.
Scoped template, layout, or content workflow improvements using the existing platform.
Testing of the agreed editor and visitor journeys, with a staging and rollback plan where available.
Editor guidance, a change record, and a list of remaining maintenance considerations.
process: Confirm the CMS version, hosting, backup process, access, and the specific issue or workflow.
Agree on a bounded change and a safe review environment before implementation.
Test the change, review it with the owner, and document deployment and ongoing responsibilities.
prepare: Share the public URL, CMS, hosting arrangement, and a description of the workflow or issue. For Craft inquiries, select WordPress support in the form and identify Craft in your message. Do not send credentials through the contact form.
boundary: Plugin or module licenses, hosting, emergency response, migrations, and ongoing maintenance require an agreed scope. No uptime, security certification, or unsupported platform compatibility is implied.

title: Digital Advertising Support
description: Paid search, display and paid social support across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) and Meta Ads, with clear landing-page and measurement scope.
intro: Connect the offer, audience, landing page and measurement before a campaign goes live.
fit: For a scoped campaign launch, a review of an existing advertising setup, or a clearer connection between paid traffic and the actions reporting should measure.
deliverables: A campaign brief covering objectives, audience, placements, messaging, landing pages and review criteria.
Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) or Meta Ads campaign setup and review within the agreed account access, media budget and scope.
Landing-page and conversion-path checks, naming and campaign parameters, with tracking dependencies identified separately.
Optimization notes and reporting in the relevant advertising platform or Data Studio, with definitions, limitations and next steps.

channels.title: Paid search
channels.intro: Connect what someone searches for to a useful offer and landing page.
channels.setup: Plan keyword themes, negative keywords, ad copy and landing-page alignment for Google Ads or Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads).
channels.review: Review available search-term reports for relevance. Refine exclusions, copy and the page journey; document the reason for changes.
channels.report: Report on available search terms, clicks, cost and agreed conversions, with attribution windows and tracking limitations.

channels.title: Display
channels.intro: Give visual creative a clear audience, placement and next step.
channels.setup: Prepare image and text variants for the selected formats. Review audience settings, placements or content exclusions, and the destination page.
channels.review: Check available placement reports and creative performance. Review exposure and frequency controls where the platform and campaign type support them.
channels.report: Document impressions, clicks, cost and defined conversions. Keep view-through and click-through attribution distinct where reported.

channels.title: Paid social
channels.intro: Match the message and creative to the people you want to reach.
channels.setup: Plan Meta Ads audience settings, creative and copy variants, placements, and the intended action on a landing page or approved lead form.
channels.review: Review delivery, audience and creative breakdowns where available. Document changes and check the handoff from the ad to the intended action.
channels.report: Separate engagement from confirmed inquiries or purchases. Report agreed conversion definitions and attribution settings alongside results.

process: Review the offer, audience, existing account structure and visitor journey. Agree on the objective, budget authority, access and success measures.
Prepare the agreed campaign structure, messaging and landing-page handoff. Review links, tracking dependencies and approval checkpoints before launch.
Review campaign and conversion data against agreed definitions. Document changes, reporting limitations and the next decisions.
prepare: Share the business objective, audience or service area, landing page and advertising platforms in use. Account access is arranged through platform permissions; do not send passwords or customer lists through the inquiry form.
boundary: Account access, media budget, creative production and ongoing management require an agreed scope. Tracking and consent configuration have their own implementation scope.
